blind.description: A stylized stone archway or portal structure. It features two square stone pillars with stepped plinths and capital mouldings, connected at the bottom by a stepped stone threshold slab. The top forms a semicircular masonry arch topped with a prominent raised rectangular keystone. Set into the keystone on both sides is a purple circular gem above a bronze stud, and the curved arch segments each feature three round bronze metal studs inset along both front and back faces. The stone is textured with weathered grey-beige masonry and green moss growing in crevices and along the base.
blind.from_above: A wide, thin rectangular bar representing the top curve and keystone of the arch, flanked by protruding round studs, with the wider stepped base visible below the central opening.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.1 to 1.2 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 6.5 to 7 ft tall) and about 4 to 5 ft wide.
